mapper.select: SELECT * FROM resource_skill_ratings WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId} AND service_id = #{serviceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resource_skill_ratings ( tenant_id, resource_id, service_id, avg_rating, rating_count, total_rating_points, five_star_count, four_star_count, three_star_count, two_star_count, one_star_count, last_rated_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{resourceId}, #{serviceId}, #{avgRating}, #{ratingCount}, #{totalRatingPoints}, #{fiveStarCount}, #{fourStarCount}, #{threeStarCount}, #{twoStarCount}, #{oneStarCount}, #{lastRatedAt}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(), UTC_TIMESTAMP() )
mapper.update: UPDATE resource_skill_ratings SET avg_rating = #{avgRating}, rating_count = #{ratingCount}, total_rating_points = #{totalRatingPoints}, five_star_count = #{fiveStarCount}, four_star_count = #{fourStarCount}, three_star_count = #{threeStarCount}, two_star_count = #{twoStarCount}, one_star_count = #{oneStarCount}, last_rated_at = #{lastRatedAt}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId} AND service_id = #{serviceId}

UPDATE resource_skill_ratings SET total_rating_points = total_rating_points + #{rating}, rating_count = rating_count + 1, five_star_count = five_star_count + 10, four_star_count = four_star_count + 10, three_star_count = three_star_count + 10, two_star_count = two_star_count + 10, one_star_count = one_star_count + 10, avg_rating = (total_rating_points + #{rating}) / (rating_count + 1), last_rated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId} AND service_id = #{serviceId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM resource_skill_ratings WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId} AND service_id = #{serviceId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM resource_skill_ratings WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId} AND service_id = #{serviceId}
